queries.name: tables

queries.name: columns
queries.sql: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type,is_nullable,column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='simus' ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

queries.name: constraints
queries.sql: SELECT c.relname AS table_name,k.conname AS constraint_name,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='simus' ORDER BY c.relname,k.conname

queries.name: functions
queries.sql: SELECT p.proname AS function_name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='simus' ORDER BY p.proname

queries.name: sessions_and_content
queries.sql: SELECT s.id AS session_id,s.status,s.npc_motion->>'map_version' AS map_version,s.npc_motion->>'path_version' AS path_version,count(t.id)::int AS situation_count,array_agg(t.code ORDER BY t.code) FILTER(WHERE t.id IS NOT NULL) AS situation_codes FROM simus.simulation_sessions s LEFT JOIN simus.session_situations t ON t.session_id=s.id GROUP BY s.id,s.status ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 100

queries.name: targeted_situations
queries.sql: SELECT s.id AS session_id,s.status,t.code,t.id AS situation_id FROM simus.simulation_sessions s JOIN simus.session_situations t ON t.session_id=s.id WHERE t.code=ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY s.id,t.code LIMIT 160

queries.name: seed_template_presence
queries.sql: SELECT id,status FROM simus.simulation_sessions WHERE id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY id

queries.name: event_summary
queries.sql: SELECT trigger_kind,status,count(*)::int AS occurrence_count FROM simus.npc_events GROUP BY trigger_kind,status ORDER BY trigger_kind,status
